Lemon Artichoke Rice
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:21pm

Ingredients




1 jar (4 oz) marinated artichoke hearts
1 1/2 cups Uncooked white rice
2 tablespoons Fresh lemon juice
1 teaspoon Fresh lemon zest
1 Garlic clove, put through a press
1/4 teaspoon Fresh ground black pepper
Water
1 tablespoon Chopped fresh parsley
Sliced black olives - optional

Preparation

1 Place rice in a rice cooker with the lemon juice; then fill with water to the two cup mark. Drain and chop the artichoke hearts and add to the cooker with two tabsp of the marinade. Stir in all the remaining ingredients, except the parsley. Cover and cook until the timer dings. Allow to rest on the warm setting without lifting the cover at least 10 mins. Just before serving, stir in the chopped fresh parsley. Garnish with the sliced black olives.
